meta_description:
28K likes, 254 comments - wangchuksworld on September 27, 2026: "A HEART TO HEART CHAT WITH THE NATION...
Not just a Press Release. 
One year after my first morning in Jodhpur Central Jail where I was kept in total isolation for six months under the draconian NSA, I have more questions than I had before. 
Unfortunately there was a media blackout on Ladakh 3 days ago when I voiced these questions from Leh as Ladakh observed Martyrs Day in memory for those who lost their lives last year on the same day. Here are some of those questions I asked from Delhi today. 
I'm sure the NATION WANTS TO KNOW TOO...
#Ladakh #JusticeForLadakh #AmitShahMustResign #NeetPaperLeak".
